description: This is a test class for the PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.security.authentication.preauth package. The class contains unit tests verifying the behavior of the provider, including applicability checks and extraction of authentication credentials from HTTP headers and query parameters.

classes.name: PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider, testing applicability checks, authentication extraction, and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup method to initialize test state before each test.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Test whether the provider correctly recognizes a request with a dummy authentication header as applicable.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthQueryParam
methods.description: Test whether the provider correctly recognizes a request with a dummy query parameter as applicable.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthQueryParamAndDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Test applicability when both header and query param are present.

methods.name: isApplicableFails
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly reports non-applicability when neither header nor query param are present.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFails
methods.description: Verify that authentication extraction fails when no header or query param is present.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFailsWithEmptyDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Verify failure when the dummy auth header has an empty value.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFailsWithEmptyDummyAuthQueryParam
methods.description: Verify failure when the dummy auth query parameter has an empty value.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByHeader
methods.description: Test successful extraction of authentication from header.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByQueryParam
methods.description: Test successful extraction of authentication from query parameter.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByQueryParamAndHeader
methods.description: Test successful extraction of authentication when both header and query param are present.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResultExtractsDittoRuntimeExceptionFromCause
methods.description: Verify that the failure reason is correctly extracted when the cause is a DittoRuntimeException wrapped in an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Ensure the method correctly returns a failed AuthenticationResult with a provided exception.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Test that the provider returns the correct authorization context type for a given request.

methods.name: mockRequestContext
methods.description: Helper method to create a mock RequestContext with specified header and query parameter.
